verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              नृसिंह एष कथितो भूयोऽयं वामनोऽपरः। यत्र वामनमास्थाय रूपं रूपविदां वरः॥१॥
verses.english: He forcibly brought all the oceans and rivers to his control, himself manifesting as a single entity of mega-water; as for the rivers, whether belonging to earth or flowing from heaven, and that are so far naturally and snugly stream-bedded by fixed mountains, he unnaturally diverted their course to himself, desirous of enjoying their husbandhood… thus he succeeded in establishing a de-naturalised world…

verses.sanskrit: बलेर्बलवतो यज्ञे बलिना विष्णुना पुरा। विक्रमस्त्रिभिराक्रम्य त्रैलोक्यमखिलं हृतम्॥२॥
समुद्रवसना चोर्वी नानानगविभूषिता। हृत्वा दत्ता सुरेन्द्राय शक्राय प्रभविष्णुना॥३॥
verses.english: Although his arms are chopped off and his heads are cut off, that dAnava काल-नेमि did not flinch the least but still stood in the battle like the trunk of a tree shorn of all its branches…

verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              अत्र मे संशयो ब्रह्मन्नत्र कौतूहलं महत्। कथं नारायणो देवो वामनत्वमुपागतः॥४॥
verses.english: You are the only destroyer of this काल-नेमि whom you have just slain in battle… save thee; there is none else capable of it…

verses.sanskrit: यः पुराणे पुराणात्मा भूत्वा नारायणः प्रभुः। पद्मनाभो महाबाहुर्लोकानां प्रकृतिर्ध्रुवः॥५॥
verses.english: May I ask you now to return the prosperous triad of worlds to high-souled indra since the thorns called demons are prised out in this war…?” so said brahma to viShNu.
verses.bhavadeepa: अत्र मे इति। नारायण इति प्रख्यातरीत्या कृत्स्नब्रह्माण्डलयस्थानभूतब्रह्माण्डदेवासुरविभागमुपजीव्य देवानां पक्षपातेनासुरान् विध्वंसयतीत्युक्तं सर्वात्मनः स्वावयवेष्विव तेषु विषमबुद्ध्ययोगादिति शङ्कार्थः॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: अनादिमध्यनिधनस्त्रैलोक्यादिः सनातनः। देवदेवः सुराध्यक्षः कृष्णो लोकनमस्कृतः॥६॥
verses.english: Such a demon काल-नेमि whose sheen matches the gloss of deathly Time has been eliminated by you, for which I am highly pleased…

verses.sanskrit: हव्यकव्यवहः श्रीमान्हव्यकव्यभुगव्ययः। अदित्या देवमातुश्च कथं गर्भेऽभवत्प्रभुः। स्रष्टा यो वासवस्थापि स कथं वासवानुजः॥७॥
प्रसूतो देवदेवेशो विष्णुत्वं प्राप्तवान्कथम्। एतदाचक्ष्व मे विप्र प्रादुर्भावं महात्मनः॥८॥
verses.english: This one is our enemy, a perpetual enemy right from our forefathers, even an enemy of earliest known demons living underwater, namely मधु and कैटभ; This one is that challenger with whom, they say, a confrontation is unslakeable – अ-श्याम्य, such as he is he eliminated many of our demons inveigling them to warfield… This one is that merciless one in battles, diversely weaponed, shamelessly presumptuous like a boy, and who wiped off the vermilion powder from the parting of female demons’ combed hair– सीमन्त सिन्दूरम्…

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              शृणु राजन्कथां दिव्यामर्चितामृषिपुङ्गवैः। पुराणैः कविभिः प्रोक्तां ब्रह्मोक्तां ब्राह्मणेरिताम्॥९॥
verses.english: This one is that विष्णु among all the sons of lady अदिति, who eventually became gods; this is the dweller of वैकुण्ठ as the other celestials like वसु-s, रुद्र-s, मरुत्-s et al hypothesize him; This is the one that has eternal serpent which carries world on its hood, namely अनन्त, or आदि-शेष, as his bed; this one is waters and this is the one who is afloat on seawater – a self-created creator of creator brahma…
verses.bhavadeepa: विष्णुत्वं वामनस्यापि कथं त्रैलोक्यव्यापकत्वं चेति भावः॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: मारीचस्य सुरेशस्य कश्यपस्य प्रजापतेः। अदितिर्दितिर्द्वे भार्ये भगिन्यौ जनमेजय॥१०॥
verses.english: This one is that God Almighty of all gods and this one alone is the standing vitriol of ours; this one’s high fury caused the death of my father, demon हरण्य-कशिपु…
verses.bhavadeepa: उत्तरमाह- शृण्विति। दिव्यां लौकिकदृष्टान्तागम्याम् अथापि ऋषिपुङ्गवैर्मन्त्रद्रष्टृप्रवरैरर्चितां कविभिर्ब्रह्मनिष्ठैः स्वानुभवप्रामाण्येन प्रकर्षेणोक्तां ब्रह्मोतां मन्त्रसूचितां ब्राह्मणे मन्त्रविवरणरूपेऽपि ईरिताम्। अयं भावः- “इन्द्रो मायाभिः पुरुरूप ईयते” इत्यादिश्रुतौ एकस्यां मायायामसमवेतं बहुवचनं पाशन्यायेन तदवयवेषु सत्त्वरजस्तमःसु पर्यवस्यति। तत्र सत्त्वप्रधानानि रूपाणि देवतादीनि। रजः प्रधानानि यक्षरक्षःप्रभृतीनि। तमःप्रधानानि भूतप्रेतादीनि त्रिविधानीन्द्रस्य रूपाणि। तैः सत्त्वकार्यं कदाचिदुपकरोति कदाचिदुभयस्याप्याभिभवं करोति उभयेनाप्यभिभूयते च। तदेवं मूलगुणानां यथा विरोध एवं तत्प्रधानानां देवादीनामपि। तत्र यथा सलिलस्य माधुर्यम् इक्षुद्राक्षादौ बीजगुणादतिशयेनाविर्भवति। निम्बूमरीचरसादौ तु निरवशेषेणावृत्तं भवति। औपाधिकं चाम्लकटुत्वादिकम् अतीव प्रकाशते। एवमिन्द्रस्य स्वरूपभूतं ज्ञानं सात्विकेषु देवतादिष्वाविर्भवति इतरेष्वनु तस्य तिरोभावः औपाधिकानां च कामक्रोधादीनामतिशयेनाविर्भावो भवति। इन्द्रस्यापि सविशेषरूपवतः स्वरूपप्रकाशहेतुत्वाद्देवेषु पक्षपातः। तत्तिरोधानहेतुत्वादितरेषु द्रोहश्च युज्यते। सति हीन्द्रस्य पञ्च रूपाणि भूबीजाङ्कुरतरुफलोपमानि शुद्धशबलसूत्रविराड्विष्णुसंज्ञानि। तत्र शुद्धं निर्विशेषम्। विष्णुस्तु सर्व विशेषयुक्तो राजवच्छिष्टेष्वनुग्रहं दुष्टेषु द्रोहं च करोतीति युज्यत एवं स्वाङ्गमपि “त्याज्यो दुष्टः प्रियोऽप्यासीद्दष्टोऽङ्गुष्ठ इवाहिना।” इति न्यायेन बाधितुं शक्यमेव। मायावित्वाच्चास्य वामनत्वं व्यापकत्वं च युज्यत इति सर्वमनवद्यम्॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: अदित्यां जज्ञिरे देवाः कश्यपस्य महात्मनः। धातार्यमा च मित्रश्च वरुणोंऽशो भगस्तथा॥११॥
verses.english: Either in your own houses, or in heaven, or on battlefields especially you gods should not think that you are invulnerable, for demons are knavish…

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो विवस्थान्पूषा च पर्जन्यो दशमस्तथा। तथैकादशमस्त्वष्टा द्वादशो विष्णुरुच्यते॥१२॥
verses.english: On addressing the gods that magnificent nArAyaNa, whose prowess is truth, went to the abode of brahma along with brahma…

verses.sanskrit: दित्यां जातो हि बलवान्हिरण्यकशिपुः प्रभुः। तस्यानुजस्य दैत्येन्द्रो हिरण्याक्षः प्रतापवान्॥१३॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the forty-eight chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the elimination of demon काल-नेमि in starwars

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्राः पञ्च घोरपराक्रमाः। प्रह्रादश्चानुह्रादश्च जम्भः संह्राद एव च॥१४॥
verses.english: This one is that god of fatality unto demons, but now I am his fatality because I am standing up to his authority; if this invidious god oversteps his bounds he will reap the fruit of it…

verses.sanskrit: विरोचनश्च प्राह्लादिस्तिस्य पुत्रो बलिः स्मृतः। पुत्रपौत्रं च बलवत्तेषामक्षयमव्ययम्॥१५॥
verses.english: This one is that god विष्णु who by mere chance is available in my fore… now, will he truckle to me by my valour… else, will he get battered with my arrows… which one he prefers…

verses.sanskrit: तेजस्विनां सुरारीणां दैत्येन्द्राणां मनस्विनाम्। गणाः सुबहुशो राजन्देशे देशे सहस्रशः॥१६॥
verses.english: O, janamejaya this is the marvellous event about which you asked me to detail, occurred during the battling of demons spearheaded by तारक when they confronted viShNu…

verses.sanskrit: ते दृष्ट्वा नारासिंहेन हिरण्यकशिपुं हतम्। दैत्या देववधार्थाय बलिमिन्द्रं प्रचक्रिरे॥१७॥
verses.english: This one is that interminable god previously renowned as a god with lotus-navel who eliminated two glorious demons मधु and कैटभ that went underwater, when whole universe became one sheet of water, just by placing them within his knee-joints…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा धर्मपरं नित्यं सत्यवाक्यं जितेन्द्रियम्। शौर्याध्ययनसम्पन्नं सर्वज्ञानविशारदम्॥१८॥
verses.english: This one is that interminable god previously renowned as a god with lotus-navel who eliminated two glorious demons मधु and कैटभ that went underwater, when whole universe became one sheet of water, just by placing them within his knee-joints…

verses.sanskrit: परावरगृहीतार्थं तत्वदार्शिनमव्ययम्। तेजस्विनं सुररिपुं हिरण्यकशिपुं यथा॥१९॥
verses.english: This one is that god who on assuming half-lion and half-man physique singly killed my father हिरण्य-कशिपु in the days of yore…

verses.sanskrit: अभिषेकेण दिव्येन बालं वैरोचनिं तथा। दैत्याधिपत्ये दितिजास्तदा सर्वेऽभ्यपूजन्॥२०॥
verses.english: This one is that god whom the auspicious lady अदिति once conceived, as if she is a celestial wood-stick wishing to produce fire, and delivered as a dwarf-boy, who at a time when emperor बलि is conducting a vedic ritual singly appropriated all the three worlds, taking just three strides…

verses.sanskrit: अभिषिक्तस्तदा दैत्यैर्बलिर्बलवतां वरः। ब्रह्मणा चैव तुष्टेन हिरण्यकशिपोः पदे॥२१॥
verses.english: Thus addressed by god brahma, shrIhari said to gods through their mouthpiece, namely indra, in these auspicious words…

verses.sanskrit: अभिषिक्तोऽसुरगणैर्बलिर्वैरोचनिस्तदा। काञ्चनैः कलशैःस्फीतैः सर्वतीर्थाम्बुसंवृतैः॥२२॥
verses.english: “Limited is thy prideful strength, oh, दैत्य काल-नेमि, yet thou furiously speakest a specious rant… slain thou art, for thou goest over the threshold of tolerance with flaws in thy heart… thou art a wretch, methinks, thus fie on thy vaunting words… thine roaring is behovely amongst females than males… I behold thee, oh दैत्य, too willing to tread the path of thy predecessors… who liveth peacefully on rending a tideline that प्रजापति has ordained… I shall now eliminate thee that thwarted the activity of gods, restoring celestials to their respective positions…” so said विष्णु to काल-नेमि…

verses.sanskrit: जयशब्दं ततश्चक्रुराभिषिक्तस्य दानवाः। बलेरतुलवीर्यस्य सिंहासनगतस्य वै॥२३॥
verses.english: When nArAyaNa had said this to demon काल-नेमि in battle, that demon furiously laughed off, filled his hands with various weapons, raised those hundred hands that are gripping various weapons, and with his eyes doubly bloodshot, he smote shrIhari on chest at a place where that god is sporting a mark called श्रीवत्स…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वेन्द्रं दानवाः सर्वे बालिं बलवतां वरम्। तपो विज्ञापयामासुः शिरोभिः पतिताः क्षितौ॥२४॥
verses.english: On seeing lonely विष्णु unaided by other gods, other dAnavA-s headed by मय end तारक rushed towards him with upraised weapons… although the highly powerful daityA-s assailed him armed with various weapons god shrIhari remained unshaken in the battle like a mountain when midgets rattle it…

verses.sanskrit:
दैत्या ऊचुः।
              विदितं तव दैत्येन्द्र हिरण्यकशिपो यथा। त्रैलोक्यमासीदखिलं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥२५॥
पितामहं तु हत्वा ते सुरेश्वरनिषूदन। हृतं तदैव त्रैलोक्यं शक्रश्चैवाभिषेचितः॥२६॥
verses.english: When काल-नेमि grappled with the golden-winged गरुड to futility, he resorted to a mammoth mace, consolidating all his life-force he twirled it overhead and released that dreadful and blazing mace on that eagle, while viShNu watched all this astonishing at the impudence of that demon…

verses.sanskrit: तत्पितामहराज्यं त्वं प्रत्याहर्तुमिहार्हसि। अस्माभिः सहितो नाथ त्रैलोक्यमिदमव्ययम्। प्रत्यानयस्व भद्रं ते राज्यं पैतामहं प्रभो॥२७॥
verses.english: “Limited is thy prideful strength, oh, दैत्य काल-नेमि, yet thou furiously speakest a specious rant… slain thou art, for thou goest over the threshold of tolerance with flaws in thy heart… thou art a wretch, methinks, thus fie on thy vaunting words… thine roaring is behovely amongst females than males… I behold thee, oh दैत्य, too willing to tread the path of thy predecessors… who liveth peacefully on rending a tideline that प्रजापति has ordained… I shall now eliminate thee that thwarted the activity of gods, restoring celestials to their respective positions…” so said विष्णु to काल-नेमि…

verses.sanskrit: असुरगणसहस्रसंवृतस्त्वं जय दिवि देवगणान्महानुभावान्। अमितबलपराक्रमोऽसि राजन्नतिशयसे स्वगुणैः पितामहं स्वम्॥२८॥
verses.english: When that club fell on the head of that king of birds, सुपर्ण, that eagle crash-landed and hopped on earth with a wounded body. Beholding wounded सुपर्ण, viShNu felt that his own body is scathed, then that dweller of वैकुण्ठ took up his discus with eyes reddened in anger…
